Total 16 collectives but smaller per-rank payloads (16384/224 per reduce-scatter), potentially better network utilization on multi-node topology. Local projection operates on scattered chunks.

Reduces cross-node bandwidth pressure at cost of additional intra-node collectives. Best when inter-node bandwidth is the bottleneck.
